description: Current water level (W, cm) and discharge (Q, m3/s) for one German federal waterway gauge from PEGELONLINE (WSV), with the reading timestamp. Default station is KAUB (Middle Rhine, a key barge bottleneck). Barging capacity is not calculated; this is gauge data only. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

station.description: PEGELONLINE station short name, e.g. KAUB, EMMERICH, COLOGNE (default KAUB)

title: Logistics Rhine River Water Levels
